name: Spec-Gaussian
definition: A method that utilizes anisotropic spherical Gaussians to approximate 3D scene appearance to handle complex shading like specular and anisotropic components.
summary: Spec-Gaussian models specular and anisotropic reflections in 3D Gaussian Splatting by replacing standard spherical harmonics with Anisotropic Spherical Gaussians to capture sharp highlights.
